name: export_views_to_image
description: Export printable views to image files (PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF).

elementIds.description: The views ids to export. Required for 'ByViewList' mode, ignored for other modes.

directoryPath.description: The fully qualified directory path where the image files will be saved. Filenames are auto-generated. If not provided, saves to user's Documents folder.

imageFormat.description: Image format: PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF. Default is PNG.

exportMode.description: Export mode: 'ByViewList' (export list of views by IDs, default), 'CurrentView' (export current active view), 'VisibleRegion' (export visible portion of current window as user sees it on screen). Default is 'ByViewList'.

revitInstanceId.description: Process ID of the Revit instance to call. Use get_running_revit_instances to list available instances.
